game_title: Print Tracer – Buried Temple Steps Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps, steps of a half-buried temple: the camel trader must handle sandstorms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Print Tracer: Insert print statements at the right lines to reveal what sandstorms changed.
theme: Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps: steps of a half-buried temple
core_gameplay_loop: In Buried Temple Steps, repeat each round: Insert print statements at the right lines to reveal what sandstorms changed. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the trace_clarity value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 6 consecutive correct decisions about trace_clarity to power up the camel trader and open the camel pen.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 3 (intro tier): Print Tracer
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sandstorms in Buried Temple Steps.
